release_notes:
Hello Bibliophiles, Sol-Searchers, and Weekend Warriors of Words,

Hold on to your bookmarks, because we're dropping an update that will have you flipping (digital) pages like never before! Version 0.6.999 (soon to be 0.7.0) is here, and it's a milestone we couldn't be prouder of. We’re talking serious upgrades that take your reading to the next level. This is possibly the biggest update we've ever done.

Changes since 0.6.999 private release
* Speed up book loading (move TOC to EPUB)
* Fix low-RAM issue that caused the remote to sometimes take > 1 min to connect
* Make content sync more reliable by working around flakey floating point math.
* Fix some crashes on background sync timeouts (not user visible)
* Fix some crashes due to race conditions at shutdown (not user visible)
* Fix a freeze that happened when an article title ended in unicode

Changes since 0.6.99 private release:
* Dictionaries!! (see below)
* Fixed crash in content sync
* Fixed crash at start of TOC
* Fixed crash in summaries
* Fixed crash when unicode character is last character in article title
* Corrected kerning of 'r' followed by a comma
* Fixed split words when divided by '<a>' tags

A Format You've Been Waiting For
* EPUB is Here! – we've rewritten nearly the entire text parsing and layout system to be compliant with EPUBv3! Native support for EPUB in the glasses brings a wealth of features like basic text formatting, chapter progress in the popup menu, and wait for it... images! A picture is worth a thousand words, and now you don't have to choose between them!

Knowledge at Your Fingertips
* Dictionary Definitions Powered by GPT – Unfamiliar with a word? No need to haul out the Oxford English Dictionary. Now, you can see brief definitions of the most complex words in your chapter, all thanks to OpenAI's GPT. Expand your vocabulary without missing a beat!

Speed and Efficiency
* Turbo-Charged Downloads – We've revved up the download speed during content sync, so your next read lands on your glasses faster than you can say "Proust."
* Battery Light Sanity – Fixed an issue where the battery light wouldn’t go green when charging. Now you can easily tell when it's "Go" time!

Intelligent Tweaks
* Text Boundaries, But Make It Sane – We’ve constrained text bounding boxes to more reasonable dimensions, improving your reading experience.
* Telemetry Enhancements – Added data collection for lighting & style changes. This helps us tailor the reading experience to what’s actually comfortable for you.
* Page Navigation Fixed – No more stuck pages at the end of your books. Now, turning back is as smooth as a well-oiled library cart wheel.
* Firmware Upgrade Logic – The "upgrade firmware" menu item now only shows if the firmware is actually newer, eliminating any unnecessary confusion.

And because we love to end on a high note, here's a joke for sticking around:

What do you call a snowman with a six-pack? An abdominal snowman!

Keep those pages turning,
The Sol Reader Team
